subject: Northbridge cohort promotional subsidy request and next steps
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara@northbridge.org>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:03-07:00
Subject: Intro: Northbridge cohort — promo pricing ask

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. I'm Sara, Program Director at Northbridge Accelerator — we run two cohorts a year (25 startups each) focusing on infra/ML tooling. We're finalizing vendor partners for our Winter cohort and wanted to explore Redwood's promotional pricing for early-stage participants.

High level: most companies are pre-revenue and would benefit from a combination of free credits and a discounted onboarding package. Our ask is whether Redwood can provide a cohort-level subsidy (covering token usage and onboarding support) so founders can build with real usage during the first 3–6 months.

What we can offer in return: official partner listing, a short joint webinar, and a single PO from Northbridge covering the subsidy (we have a small sponsor budget).

Attached is a preliminary list of the cohort (names/redacted emails) and a one-pager on expected usage patterns. Can you let me know what a feasible promo structure looks like and what approvals you need? Happy to jump on a 30-minute sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Program Director — Northbridge Accelerator
ops@northbridge.org

Attachment: cohort_participants.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara@northbridge.org>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Northbridge cohort — promo pricing ask

Hi Sara — great to meet you (and thanks for the doc). Short answer: yes, we typically support accelerator cohorts with a combined package of credits + discounted onboarding. I'd propose the following starting point so we can align internal approvals quickly:

- Proposal: 75,000 free inference credits pooled across the cohort (to be allocated by Northbridge) + 30% onboarding services discount for each startup for the first 90 days.
- Governance: Northbridge provides a single PO to Redwood covering any sponsor contribution; Redwood issues sponsor codes for cohort members to redeem credits.
- Requirements: HubSpot deal record and signed order form (DocuSign) to lock the subsidy and billing treatment.
- Ops asks: a short kickoff with our Solutions Engineer and a CSV with company contact + billing contact for each team.

Next steps I suggest: (1) Marcus and Priyom to confirm billing/finance/legal constraints, (2) we prepare a promo term sheet and Order Form, (3) schedule a 30-min kickoff before the cohort starts.

I'm looping in Marcus (Revenue Ops) and Priyom (Partnerships) to scope approvals and finalize the term sheet. Availability for a quick call: tomorrow 10:00–11:30am or Friday afternoon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0194

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:03:15-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Northbridge cohort — promo pricing ask

Vanessa / Sara,

Thanks for the clear proposal. Finance/legal have a few guardrails but we can support the ask with the following binding term sheet (high level):

- Promo allocation: 75,000 free inference credits to be redeemed by cohort members; credits expire 12 months from issuance.
- Additional discount: 30% off Redwood Professional onboarding fee for each accepted startup (applies to first invoice only).
- Billing: Northbridge may issue a PO to Redwood for any sponsor contribution. If Redwood is invoiced by Northbridge, revenue will be recognized as deferred sponsorship and is subject to our order form terms.
- Compliance: No customer data will be retained beyond standard retention in hosted trials; any dedicated/private deployment requests will require separate security review and SOW.
- Legal: We need a signed Order Form (DocuSign) that references the HubSpot deal id.

Operational notes: we'll issue unique sponsor codes for the cohort (one per accepted startup). Redemption will be handled by our Partner Ops team — they will contact each founder to set up billing profiles and apply credits. Please include Paula (budget@northbridge.org) on the PO.

I've attached a draft promo term sheet for review — it includes the exact credit accounting language we need. Once Sara confirms, Priyom can generate the HubSpot deal and I will open the internal finance ticket for deferred revenue handling.

Attachment: promo_term_sheet.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Vanessa / Marcus / Priyom — this looks great, thank you. Northbridge is happy to proceed with the 75k credit pool + 30% onboarding discount. I'll confirm Paula (our budget owner) will issue a single PO for the sponsor amount and send the PO to the email you confirm.

Please send the DocuSign order form and the HubSpot link you need, and I'll get the PO and the company CSV over by end of week. We can target the kickoff call for next Monday at 11am PT.

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — excited to get our founders into Redwood.

Best,
Sara
Program Director — Northbridge Accelerator
